parameters.query:
-- Paper III.i reference: (1) settled AGORA jobs, (2) live bids on comparable jobs,
-- (3) the seller's own history in this category. (4) Agent Market prices: not wired yet.
SELECT price FROM (
  SELECT j.agreed_price AS price
    FROM jobs j
   WHERE j.category = $2 AND j.status IN ('settled', 'released') AND j.agreed_price IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x.price
    FROM bids x JOIN jobs j ON j.id = x.job_id
   WHERE j.category = $2 AND x.job_id <> $1::uuid
     AND x.status IN ('live', 'shortlisted', 'accepted')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT j.agreed_price
    FROM jobs j
   WHERE j.category = $2 AND j.seller_id = $3::uuid AND j.id <> $1::uuid
     AND j.status IN ('settled', 'released') AND j.agreed_price IS NOT NULL
) r
LIMIT 200;

UPDATE bids
   SET price_check = $2::price_check_result,
       reference_median = $3::numeric,
       reference_sample_size = $4::int,
       hold_reason = $5,
       status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'held' THEN 'held'::bid_status ELSE status END
 WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id;
